objective.name: sandbox.dsl.remote.matter.chain
objective.description: Cross-instance DSL chain that builds params, writes a remote matter, reads it back, and consumes the remote fields locally.

#root.role: Build a local record, write it into a remote matter through the external route, read that remote matter back, and terminate through a local consumer wrapper.

effects.external_matter_write: One remote matter revision is updated through the external route.
effects.external_matter_read: The newly written remote matter is read back through the external route.
effects.local_wrapper_runtime: Local wrapper capacities build and consume the record.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local message becomes a locally consumed summary after one built record is written into a remote matter and read back.
invariants: The remote matter write uses the record built locally by sandbox.build.record as the source of functional.message and functional.source_ctx.
The terminal local wrapper consumes only the committed remote matter values returned by the remote matter.read.
success: The terminal payload exposes summary and ctx_id from sandbox.consume.record after the remote matter round-trip.
The remote matter revision stores the built composed message and the originating local context id.
failure: The flow fails if the remote matter write or remote matter read cannot be completed across the external boundary.
The flow fails if the local record build or terminal wrapper consumption fails.
notes: This scenario validates remote matter mutation and remote readback inside one DSL flow.
The N7 harness verifies both the terminal wrapper payload and the committed remote matter contents.
